lessons.title: Welcome!
lessons.subtitle: 初次见面与问候
objectives: 向初次见面的人打招呼

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Yes! Hi there! Are you Pete?

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Let's try that again. I'm Anna. Nice to meet you.
segments.chinese: 我们再来一次。我是安娜，很高兴认识你。

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.chinese: 我是皮特。“Anna”是拼成 A-N-A 吗？

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: Well, Anna with two "n's" ... Welcome to ... 1400 Irving Street!
segments.chinese: 好吧，名字里有两个 n 的安娜……欢迎来到欧文街 1400 号！

explanations.title: 用 be 介绍和确认身份
explanations.text: I am + 名字表示“我是……”。问对方是不是某人时，用 Are you + 名字?；肯定回答可用 Yes。
explanations.example: I am Pete. / Are you Anna?

explanations.title: 初次见面的礼貌问候
explanations.text: Nice to meet you 用于初次见面。Hi there 比较随意；不要把 there 在这里理解为指路。

questions.prompt: 谁欢迎安娜来到欧文街？
questions.explanation: 皮特说 Welcome to ... 1400 Irving Street，欢迎安娜来到新住处。

questions.prompt: 安娜的名字怎样拼写？
questions.explanation: 安娜用 No 纠正皮特，名字中有两个 n。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出皮特介绍自己的完整一句。
questions.explanation: I am + 名字用来介绍自己。注意 Pete 是人名。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜第一次说的见面问候。
questions.explanation: Nice to meet you 表示初次见面时的“很高兴认识你”。

questions.prompt: 初次见面，怎样用英语说“很高兴认识你”？
questions.explanation: 固定表达 Nice to meet you 中的 to 不能省略。

questions.prompt: 补全问句：___ you Anna?（你是安娜吗？只填空缺词）
questions.explanation: 询问 You are ... 是否成立时，把 are 放在 you 前面。

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: She is Anna. She is new to D.C.
segments.chinese: 她是安娜。她刚来到华盛顿特区。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I am from a small town.

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.chinese: 那欢迎你来到华盛顿特区。

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.english: I am Jonathan. I am in apartment B4.
segments.chinese: 我是乔纳森。我住在 B4 公寓。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I am in apartment C2. Marsha is my roommate.
segments.chinese: 我住在 C2 公寓。玛莎是我的室友。

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.english: I know Marsha. She is nice.

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: And I am in Apartment D7. I have to go now.
segments.chinese: 我住在 D7 公寓。我现在得走了。

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: Remember to call Marsha at work. Tell her you’re here.
segments.chinese: 记得打玛莎的工作电话。告诉她你到了。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Right, thanks, Pete. Nice to meet you!
segments.chinese: 好的，谢谢你，皮特。很高兴认识你！

explanations.title: 询问来自哪里
explanations.text: Where are you from? 询问来源地。回答用 I am from + 地点；small town 前有 a。
explanations.example: I am from a small town.

explanations.title: 介绍第三个人
explanations.text: She is + 名字或身份，介绍女性第三人称。my 表示“我的”，后接名词。
explanations.example: She is Anna. / Marsha is my roommate.

questions.prompt: 安娜来自哪里？
questions.explanation: I am from a small town 直接说明她来自一个小镇，并未说出镇名。

questions.prompt: 谁是安娜的室友？
questions.explanation: 安娜说 Marsha is my roommate；roommate 是室友。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出询问来自哪里的整句问话。
questions.explanation: Where are you from? 询问来自哪里，from 放在句末。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜回答来自哪里的整句。
answers: I am from a small town.
questions.explanation: a small town 是“一个小镇”，a 不可省略。

questions.prompt: 向新朋友询问“你从哪里来？”，用本课的句型。
questions.explanation: Where + are + you + from 是本课的完整问句。

questions.prompt: 补全：Marsha is my ___.（玛莎是我的室友，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: roommate 表示共同居住的室友，不等于 friend。

lessons.title: I'm Here!
lessons.subtitle: 打电话和寻找超市
objectives: 在电话中说明自己是谁

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I am in my new apartment! Great!
segments.chinese: 我在自己的新公寓里了！太棒了！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I live with Marsha. We’re roommates.
segments.chinese: 我和玛莎住在一起。我们是室友。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I want to cook dinner. Oh! Hmmm. Is there a supermarket near here?
segments.chinese: 我想做晚饭。哦！嗯……这附近有超市吗？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Marsha knows. Marsha's work number is 555-8986.
segments.chinese: 玛莎知道。玛莎的工作电话是 555-8986。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Hello. Is this Marsha? It is Anna.
segments.chinese: 你好。请问是玛莎吗？我是安娜。

segments.speaker: Man
segments.english: I am sorry. You have the wrong number.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: One more time. 555-8986. Please be Marsha.
segments.chinese: 再试一次。555-8986。希望这次是玛莎。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Yes, Marsha. I want to cook dinner.

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: Excuse me? Anna? Is that you?

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I want to find a supermarket.

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: Oh, okay. The supermarket is at 1500 Irving Street. It is near the apartment.
segments.chinese: 哦，好的。超市在欧文街 1500 号，就在公寓附近。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: There is a big supermarket on our street. And Marsha says I am a good cook! Until next time! Bye!
segments.chinese: 我们这条街上有一家大超市。而且玛莎说我很会做饭！下次见！再见！

explanations.title: 电话中的 This is
explanations.text: 电话中用 This is + 名字说明自己是谁；Is this + 名字? 可以核实接电话者。

explanations.title: 想做某事
explanations.text: want to 后面接动词原形。不能省掉 to，也不能把 cook 改成 cooking。

questions.prompt: 安娜为什么想找超市？
questions.explanation: 她先说 I want to cook dinner，随后询问附近的超市。

questions.prompt: 超市在哪里？
questions.explanation: 玛莎给出的超市地址是 1500 Irving Street，并说离公寓很近。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜说明自己要找超市的完整一句。
answers: I want to find a supermarket.
questions.explanation: want to 后接动词原形 find，supermarket 前有 a。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出玛莎确认安娜位置的两句。
questions.explanation: there 指对方所在的地方；这里 are 与 you 搭配。

questions.prompt: 电话接通后，怎样按本课说“我是玛莎”？
questions.explanation: 电话中常用 This is + 名字说明自己是谁。

questions.prompt: 补全：I want ___ cook dinner.（只填一个词）
questions.explanation: want to do 表示想做某事，不能直接用 want cook。

lessons.title: What Is It?
lessons.subtitle: 辨认身边的物品
objectives: 用 have 说明拥有的东西

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Pete, hi! Hi, we are here!
segments.chinese: 皮特，你好！嗨，我们在这儿！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: You know, Pete, I am new to D.C. The city is big.
segments.chinese: 你知道，皮特，我刚来华盛顿特区。这座城市很大。

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: Yeah. But you learn a little more every day. How's the new apartment?
segments.chinese: 是啊。不过你每天都会多了解一点。新公寓怎么样？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: The new apartment is great! Let's get coffee!
segments.chinese: 新公寓很棒！我们去喝咖啡吧！

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: Anna, do you have a pen?

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Yes. I have a pen in my bag.

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: It is not a pen. It is a book. It is a big book.
segments.chinese: 这不是笔，这是书，是一本大书。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Yes. Yes it is, Pete. I know I have a pen, though…
segments.chinese: 是的，是的，皮特，我知道。不过我确实有一支笔……

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: It is not a pen, Anna ... a toy?
segments.chinese: 这不是笔，安娜……是玩具吗？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Pete, Marsha, I know I have a pen.
segments.chinese: 皮特，玛莎，我知道我有一支笔。

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: Why do you have a map of the world?
segments.chinese: 你为什么带着世界地图？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Pete, Marsha. Now I know I have a pen.
segments.chinese: 皮特，玛莎，现在我知道我有一支笔了。

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: And now you have a lamp.
segments.chinese: 而现在你拿出了一盏灯。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I have a pen! Let’s get coffee!
segments.chinese: 我有笔了！我们去喝咖啡吧！

explanations.title: 辨认与否定物品
explanations.text: It is a ... 说明这是什么。否定时在 is 后面加 not；单数可数名词通常需要 a 或其他限定词。
explanations.example: It is not a pen. It is a book.

explanations.title: 用 have 表达拥有
explanations.text: I have a pen 表示“我有一支笔”。疑问句 Do you have a pen? 中 have 保持原形。

questions.prompt: 玛莎想向安娜借什么？
questions.explanation: 玛莎问 Anna, do you have a pen?；之后安娜一直在包里找笔。

questions.prompt: 安娜最后找到笔后提议做什么？
questions.explanation: 结尾说 I have a pen! Let's get coffee!，明确邀请去喝咖啡。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜说笔在哪里的两句。
answers: Yes. I have a pen in my bag.
questions.explanation: in my bag 指在我的包里；have 表示拥有。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出玛莎指出那是地图的整句。
questions.explanation: it is + a + 单数名词，用于辨认物品。

questions.prompt: 用本课句型说“我有一支笔”。
questions.explanation: I have 表示“我有”；a pen 是一支笔。

questions.prompt: 补全：It is ___ a pen.（它不是笔，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: be 动词后加 not 构成否定：It is not a pen。

lessons.title: Where Are You?
lessons.subtitle: 谈论房间与活动
objectives: 描述房间里的日常活动

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Hello, everyone! Today my friend Marsha is at her friend's house. She says it is beautiful. I want to see this house! Here we are!
segments.chinese: 大家好！今天我的朋友玛莎在她朋友家。她说那儿很漂亮。我想看看这所房子！我们到了！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Marsha, I am in the kitchen! It is a beautiful kitchen!
segments.chinese: 玛莎，我在厨房！这厨房真漂亮！

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: It is beautiful. We cook in the kitchen.
segments.chinese: 是很漂亮。我们在厨房做饭。

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: We relax in the living room.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I relax in the living room. Marsha, let’s go upstairs!
segments.chinese: 我在客厅休息。玛莎，我们上楼吧！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Marsha, I am in the bathroom! I wash in the bathroom.
segments.chinese: 玛莎，我在浴室！我在浴室洗漱。

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: I am in the bedroom. We sleep in the bedroom.
segments.chinese: 我在卧室。我们在卧室睡觉。

explanations.title: 用 where 问位置
explanations.text: Where are you? 询问对方在哪里。回答可用 I am in the + 房间名。

explanations.title: 活动与房间
explanations.text: 用一般现在时谈日常活动：We cook / I eat / We relax。地点常用 in the + 房间。
explanations.example: We relax in the living room.

questions.prompt: 人们通常在哪个房间做饭？
questions.explanation: 玛莎说 We cook in the kitchen。

questions.prompt: 人们在哪个房间睡觉？
questions.explanation: 玛莎说 We sleep in the bedroom；sleep 是睡觉。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜说自己在厨房做什么的整句。
questions.explanation: eat 是吃饭；地点前用 in the。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出玛莎说在客厅做什么的整句。
answers: We relax in the living room.
questions.explanation: relax 表示休息、放松，living room 是客厅。

questions.prompt: 用本课句型说“我在卧室睡觉”。
questions.explanation: I + sleep + in the bedroom 描述日常活动和地点。

questions.prompt: 补全：Where ___ you?（你在哪里？只填一个词）
questions.explanation: you 与 are 搭配；疑问词 where 问地点。

lessons.title: Where Is the Gym?
lessons.subtitle: 询问与描述方位
objectives: 用对面、旁边和后面指路

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Hi there! I’m Anna and I live in Washington, D.C. Every day I learn more about this great city. People in Washington like to work out! Oh, hi, Pete. How’s it going?
segments.chinese: 大家好！我是安娜，住在华盛顿特区。每天我都会更了解这座美丽的城市。这里的人喜欢锻炼！哦，嗨，皮特。最近怎么样？

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: Hi, Anna. It’s going great. How’s it going with you?
segments.chinese: 嗨，安娜。一切很好。你最近怎么样？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Things are awesome! Pete, I want to work out. Where is the gym?
segments.chinese: 一切都棒极了！皮特，我想锻炼。健身房在哪儿？

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: The gym is across from the lounge. It’s next to the mailroom. Go that way.
segments.chinese: 健身房在休息室对面，在收发室旁边。往那边走。

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: No, Anna! Not that way! Go that way!
segments.chinese: 不，安娜！不是那边！往那边走！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Oh, Pete. This is not the gym.

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: That’s right, Anna. This is the mailroom.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: The gym is across from … what?

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: The gym is across from the lounge.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Across from the lounge. Right. Thanks!
segments.chinese: 在休息室对面。好的，谢谢！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Pete! This is not the gym!

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: The gym is across from the lounge. It is behind the lobby.
segments.chinese: 健身房在休息室对面，在大堂后面。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: This is not the gym. This is a parking garage.
segments.chinese: 这不是健身房，这是停车库。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: This is not a gym. This is a rooftop.
segments.chinese: 这不是健身房，这是屋顶。

segments.speaker: Pete
segments.english: I want to work out too! Join me!
segments.chinese: 我也想锻炼！和我一起吧！

explanations.title: 位置短语
explanations.text: across from 表示对面，next to 表示紧挨着，behind 表示后面。它们表达不同关系，不可互换。
explanations.example: The gym is across from the lounge.

explanations.title: 询问地点
explanations.text: Where is the gym? 中 gym 是单数。问地点用 where；is 放在主语前。

questions.prompt: 健身房在休息室的什么位置？
questions.explanation: The gym is across from the lounge；across from 是在对面。

questions.prompt: 健身房还在大堂的什么位置？
questions.explanation: 皮特补充 It is behind the lobby；behind 是在后面。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜的道谢。
questions.explanation: Thanks 是非正式的“谢谢”，后面直接称呼对方。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出皮特只说明健身房与休息室位置的完整一句。
answers: The gym is across from the lounge.
questions.explanation: across from 作为一个整体表示“在……对面”。

questions.prompt: 用本课句型问“健身房在哪里？”
questions.explanation: 单数地点 the gym 与 is 搭配。

questions.prompt: 补全：The gym is ___ the lobby.（在大堂后面，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: behind 表示在后面；不是 next to“在旁边”。

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Caty
segments.english: I am your boss, Caty Weaver. But, please call me Caty.
segments.chinese: 我是你的上司凯蒂·韦弗。不过请叫我凯蒂。

segments.speaker: Caty
segments.english: So sorry, but I am busy. Please meet your co-workers. But remember, they are busy working.
segments.chinese: 很抱歉，我很忙。去认识一下你的同事吧。不过记住，他们正忙着工作。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Nice to meet you. What are you doing?
segments.chinese: 很高兴认识你。你在做什么？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: You are writing! You are writing a lot!
segments.chinese: 你在写东西！你写了好多！

segments.speaker: Anne
segments.chinese: 拜托，拜托，请停下吧，拜托。

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.english: (in the studio) “and people all around the world are waiting to hear news about the next president…”
segments.chinese: （在演播室里）“全世界的人们都在等待有关下一任总统的消息……”

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Jonathan, hi! Remember me? I live in your building.
segments.chinese: 乔纳森，你好！还记得我吗？我和你住在同一栋楼。

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.english: Yes! And, now I have to record again!
segments.chinese: 是的！现在我得重新录了！

segments.speaker: Amelia
segments.english: The word of the day is social. Social -

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Are you reading the news? Hi!

segments.speaker: Amelia
segments.english: No, I’m reading for my show.
segments.chinese: 不是，我在为我的节目朗读。

segments.speaker: Amelia
segments.english: (to camera person) Can I read again?
segments.chinese: （对摄像师说）我可以再读一遍吗？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: This day is not going well.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I am bothering people, Ms. Weaver.
segments.chinese: 我在打扰大家，韦弗女士。

segments.speaker: Caty
segments.english: Let’s go to my office and talk.
segments.chinese: 我们去我的办公室聊聊吧。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I like to talk with you, Ms. Weaver.
segments.chinese: 我喜欢和您聊天，韦弗女士。

explanations.title: 现在进行时
explanations.text: be + 动词 ing 表示正在进行。I 用 am，you 用 are；write 变 writing 时去掉不发音的 e。

explanations.title: 询问当前活动
explanations.text: What are you doing? 问此刻正在做什么。可以用 I'm writing / I'm reading 作答。

questions.prompt: 安妮正在做什么？
questions.explanation: 安妮回答 I'm writing；后面安娜还感叹她写了很多。

questions.prompt: 乔纳森为什么要重新录制？
questions.explanation: 乔纳森正在做节目，安娜闯入打招呼后，他说 now I have to record again。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜单独询问正在做什么的整句。
questions.explanation: What are you doing? 用现在进行时询问此刻的活动。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出乔纳森说明自己正在做节目的整句。
questions.explanation: am doing 表示正在做，my show 是我的节目。

questions.prompt: 补全：I am ___.（我正在写东西，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: write 的现在分词要去掉末尾不发音的 e 再加 ing。

questions.prompt: 补全：What are you ___?（你正在做什么，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: 现在进行时由 be + 动词 ing 构成，这里用 doing。

lessons.title: Are You Busy?
lessons.subtitle: 礼貌询问与道歉
objectives: 礼貌询问对方是否忙碌

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Hello, everyone. Here I am at my new job! Yesterday at my first day of work … Well, let’s not talk about yesterday. Today is a new day! Today I want to apologize to my co-workers.
segments.chinese: 大家好。我在新工作的地方！昨天是我上班的第一天……算了，不说昨天了。今天是新的一天！今天我想向同事们道歉。

segments.speaker: Anne
segments.english: Hi, Anna. Yes. At 10 a.m. I am writing. Every day I do my morning show. Sorry!
segments.chinese: 你好，安娜。是的。上午十点我在写东西。我每天都做早间节目，抱歉！

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.english: Yes, I’m busy. When the studio light is on, I am recording my evening show.
segments.chinese: 是的，我很忙。演播室灯亮着的时候，我正在录制晚间节目。

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.english: Um, maybe another time? Right now I am busy.
segments.chinese: 嗯，也许改天吧？我现在很忙。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I want to say I’m sorry for yesterday.
segments.chinese: 我想为昨天的事说声对不起。

segments.speaker: Amelia
segments.english: It’s okay, Anna. Come by this afternoon.
segments.chinese: 没关系，安娜。今天下午过来吧。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Yes, Ms. Weaver. I am busy.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: A party! Awesome! And I still have my job! Phew! Until next time!
segments.chinese: 派对！太棒了！我还保住了工作！呼！下次见！

explanations.title: 礼貌确认对方是否忙碌
explanations.text: Are you busy? 问对方是否忙。a little busy 是“有一点忙”；right now 强调此刻。

explanations.title: 回应道歉和约时间
explanations.text: No worries 用于表示不介意。another time 是另找时间；this afternoon 是今天下午。a.m. 为上午，p.m. 为下午或晚上。
explanations.example: No worries. / Come by this afternoon.

questions.prompt: 安娜今天想对同事们做什么？
questions.explanation: 开场说 Today I want to apologize to my co-workers；她在弥补昨天的打扰。

questions.prompt: 凯蒂让安娜几点到办公室？
questions.explanation: Caty 说 My office. 5:00 p.m.，p.m. 是中午以后的时间。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出阿米莉亚说自己有点忙的整句。
questions.explanation: a little 表示程度较轻：“有一点”；缩写 I'm 读作一个整体。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出乔纳森表示不介意的两词回答。
questions.explanation: No worries 是自然的安慰回应，相当于“没关系，别担心”。

questions.prompt: 按本课用两个词回应他人的道歉：“没关系”。
questions.explanation: 本题练习固定回应 No worries；worries 用复数。

questions.prompt: 补全：Are you ___?（你忙吗，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: busy 是形容词；Are you busy? 询问对方是否有空。

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Oh, hi, everyone! Here in Washington, DC, the weather changes often. One day is cold and windy. But the next day is warm and sunny! So, every day I check the forecast. Hello, Phone? What is today’s temperature?
segments.chinese: 哦，大家好！华盛顿特区的天气经常变化。一天又冷又有风，第二天却温暖晴朗！所以我每天都查天气预报。你好，手机？今天多少度？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Oh, Celsius. That is 65 degrees Fahrenheit. That’s warm.
segments.chinese: 哦，摄氏度。那相当于华氏六十五度，很暖和。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Excuse me, Phone. Is it windy today?
segments.chinese: 打扰一下，手机。今天有风吗？

segments.speaker: Phone
segments.english: No, it is not windy today.

segments.speaker: Phone
segments.english: No, Anna. It is not snowy.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Today the weather is warm and sunny -- great for seeing Washington, D.C.
segments.chinese: 今天温暖晴朗，很适合逛逛华盛顿特区。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Phone! It is not warm and sunny! It is cold and windy and snowy!
segments.chinese: 手机！天气既不暖和也不晴朗！又冷又有风，还下着雪！

segments.speaker: Phone
segments.english: Anna, it is not cold, windy, or snowy. It is warm and sunny … in Mexico City, Mexico.
segments.chinese: 安娜，天气既不冷，也没有风或雪。天气温暖晴朗……在墨西哥的墨西哥城。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Washington weather changes often. Remember to check the forecast -- the right forecast.
segments.chinese: 华盛顿的天气经常变化。记得查预报——要查对地方。

segments.speaker: Phone
segments.english: Yes, Anna. Next time remember to check the right fore…
segments.chinese: 是的，安娜。下次记得查正确的预……

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Okay, thank you Phone. Goodbye, Phone.
segments.chinese: 好了，谢谢你，手机。再见，手机。

explanations.title: 天气问句
explanations.text: 用 Is it + 形容词 + today? 问天气。否定回答用 No, it is not ...。

explanations.title: 温度单位与预报地点
explanations.text: Celsius 是摄氏度，Fahrenheit 是华氏度。18°C 约为 64.4°F，原对话取约数 65°F。还要核实预报的城市。

questions.prompt: 手机最初给出了哪个城市的天气？
questions.explanation: 手机后来说明温暖晴朗是在 Mexico City, Mexico，安娜查错了城市。

questions.prompt: 安娜出门后实际遇到什么天气？
questions.explanation: 安娜抱怨 It is cold and windy and snowy，三种天气特征都提到了。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜询问是否晴天的整句。
questions.explanation: sunny 是晴朗的；it 指天气，today 是今天。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出手机回答今天没有风的整句。
answers: No, it is not windy today.
questions.explanation: 否定回答保留 it is not，windy 表示有风的。

questions.prompt: 补全：Is it ___ today?（今天下雪吗，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: snowy 是描述下雪天气的形容词，snow 是名词或动词。

questions.prompt: 按本课用英语问“今天晴天吗？”
questions.explanation: 天气问句可用 Is it + 天气形容词 + today?。

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Hi! Today, my friend Ashley, is coming over. I am showing her my new apartment! Oh! That’s Ashley calling.
segments.chinese: 嗨！今天我的朋友阿什莉要来。我会带她看看我的新公寓！哦，是阿什莉来电话了。

segments.speaker: Ashley
segments.english: Hi Anna! I’m coming to your apartment. Where is your apartment?
segments.chinese: 你好，安娜！我正要去你的公寓。你的公寓在哪儿？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: My apartment is near the Columbia Heights Metro.
segments.chinese: 我的公寓在哥伦比亚高地地铁站附近。

segments.speaker: Ashley
segments.english: It is near the Columbia Heights Metro?
segments.chinese: 在哥伦比亚高地地铁站附近？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Yes. Exit the Metro and turn right. Then at the bus station turn left. Then walk straight ahead.
segments.chinese: 对。出地铁站后右转，然后在公交车站左转，接着一直往前走。

segments.speaker: Ashley
segments.english: Okay. Exit Metro, turn right, turn left, then go straight ahead?
segments.chinese: 好的，出地铁站，右转，左转，再一直往前？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Yes. My apartment is near a coffee shop.
segments.chinese: 对，我的公寓在一家咖啡店附近。

segments.speaker: Ashley
segments.english: Anna, Which coffee shop? There are three coffee shops.
segments.chinese: 安娜，哪家咖啡店？这里有三家咖啡店。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Okay, my apartment is across from a big department store.
segments.chinese: 好吧，我的公寓在一家大百货商店对面。

segments.speaker: Ashley
segments.english: A big department store? Ah, I see it!
segments.chinese: 一家大百货商店？啊，我看到了！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Okay! Bye, Ashley. See you soon!
segments.chinese: 好！再见，阿什莉，一会儿见！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Ashley! Ashley! Ashley! Over here! It’s Anna! It’s Anna! Hi!
segments.chinese: 阿什莉！阿什莉！阿什莉！这边！是我，安娜！是安娜！嗨！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I love having my friends over. Come on!
segments.chinese: 我喜欢请朋友来家里。进来吧！

explanations.title: 用祈使句指路
explanations.text: 直接以动词原形开头：Exit / turn / walk。用 Then 连接下一步，注意路线顺序。
explanations.example: Exit the Metro and turn right.

explanations.title: 用地标定位
explanations.text: near 表示附近，across from 表示对面。多个同名地标时，可问 Which coffee shop?。
explanations.example: My apartment is near a coffee shop.

questions.prompt: 从地铁出来先向哪边转？
questions.explanation: 安娜先说 Exit the Metro and turn right，然后才是在公交站左转。

questions.prompt: 公寓在什么建筑的对面？
questions.explanation: 当咖啡店不足以定位时，安娜改说 across from a big department store。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜说明公寓在咖啡店附近的两句。
answers: Yes. My apartment is near a coffee shop.
questions.explanation: near 表示在附近；a coffee shop 是一家咖啡店。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出阿什莉第一次说一会儿见的两句。
questions.explanation: See you soon 是分别时说的“一会儿见”，不是路线指令。

questions.prompt: 按本课写“右转”的两个英语单词。
questions.explanation: 动词 turn 加方向 right；left 是左。

questions.prompt: 补全：walk straight ___.（一直往前走，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: straight ahead 作为方向表达表示一直向前。

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Hello! DC is a city for walking. In our neighborhood, I can do all my errands. Marsha, before we get ice cream, I need to return three books to the library. Where is the library?
segments.chinese: 你好！华盛顿特区适合步行。在我们社区里，我能把日常杂事都办好。玛莎，吃冰淇淋前，我得先去图书馆还三本书。图书馆在哪儿？

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: It is on this street on the corner.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Marsha, I can return the books here.
segments.chinese: 玛莎，我可以在这里还书。

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: Anna, what are those in the books?

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Marsha, these are letters to my family and friends back home … four letters! Is there a post office near here?
segments.chinese: 玛莎，这些是写给家乡亲友的信……四封！这附近有邮局吗？

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: Um, no. The post office is far from here. But there is a mailbox across from the store.
segments.chinese: 嗯，没有。邮局离这里很远。不过商店对面有个邮筒。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Marsha, now I need to buy stamps.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: No. Is there a bank near here?

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: There is a bank behind you.

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Thanks, Marsha. You know our neighborhood so well.
segments.chinese: 谢谢你，玛莎。你真了解我们的社区。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Now I have cash. I can buy stamps.
segments.chinese: 现在我有现金了，可以买邮票了。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Thank you, thank you letters, for sending my words… my love … to my family and friends -
segments.chinese: 谢谢你，谢谢你们，信件，谢谢你们把我的话……我的爱……送给我的家人和朋友——

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I love my new neighborhood! Everything is near our apartment! Even hair salons, and ice cream!
segments.chinese: 我喜欢我的新社区！什么都在公寓附近！连美发店和冰淇淋都有！

explanations.title: 表达办事需求
explanations.text: need to + 动词原形说明需要做某事；return books 是还书，不是买书。

explanations.title: 表示某处有某物
explanations.text: There is + 单数名词说明某处存在一个事物。位置可放在后面，如 behind you。
explanations.example: There is a bank behind you.

questions.prompt: 安娜要去图书馆做什么？
questions.explanation: 开场说 I need to return three books to the library，return 在这里是归还。

questions.prompt: 商店对面有什么？
questions.explanation: 玛莎说 there is a mailbox across from the store；邮局则离这里很远。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出玛莎询问有没有现金的整句。
questions.explanation: cash 是现金，是不可数名词，这里不加 a。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出玛莎说明哪儿卖邮票的整句。
questions.explanation: 主语 That store 是第三人称单数，所以 sell 加 s。

questions.prompt: 按本课说“你身后有一家银行”。
answers: There is a bank behind you.
questions.explanation: There is 引出一个事物；behind you 说明银行的位置。

questions.prompt: 补全：I need to ___ stamps.（我需要买邮票，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: need to 后接动词原形 buy；stamps 是邮票。

lessons.title: Meet My Family
lessons.subtitle: 介绍家人与职业
objectives: 询问和说明职业与活动

source.credit: 课文及原声：VOA Learning English — learningenglish.voanews.com

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Hello! Washington, D.C. has many beautiful parks. In fact, this park reminds me of my home very far away.
segments.chinese: 你好！华盛顿特区有许多漂亮的公园。其实，这座公园让我想起远方的家。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I'm thinking about my family. I'm feeling homesick.
segments.chinese: 我在想我的家人。我想家了。

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: Do you want to talk about it?

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.chinese: 是啊，你的照片可真不少！

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: This is my mother and this is my father. They are rodeo clowns.
segments.chinese: 这是我妈妈，这是我爸爸。他们是牛仔竞技表演的小丑。

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.chinese: 牛仔竞技表演的小丑做什么？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: They make jokes at a rodeo. They make people laugh.
segments.chinese: 他们在竞技表演中讲笑话，逗人发笑。

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: Who is that woman in the picture?
segments.chinese: 照片里的那位女士是谁？

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: That is my Aunt Lavender. She is my mom's sister. She loves gardening and makes spoons.
segments.chinese: 那是我的拉文德姨妈，她是我妈妈的姐妹。她喜欢园艺，还会做勺子。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Oh! This is my Uncle John. He is my father's brother.
segments.chinese: 哦！这是我的约翰叔伯。他是我爸爸的兄弟。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: He's a chicken farmer. And makes guitars. He's awesome, and I'm his favorite niece.
segments.chinese: 他是养鸡的农场主，还制作吉他。他很棒，我是他最喜欢的侄女。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: They are my cousins. They are my Uncle John's daughter and son.
segments.chinese: 他们是我的堂亲，是约翰叔伯的女儿和儿子。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: They raise sheep and make sweaters.

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.english: Thanks for showing me your family photos. Your family is very different.
segments.chinese: 谢谢你给我看家人的照片。你的家人很特别。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: I do feel better. Thanks for listening. I have many more photos!
segments.chinese: 我确实感觉好多了，谢谢你听我说。我还有好多照片！

segments.speaker: Marsha
segments.chinese: 是啊，是啊，你确实还有好多。

segments.speaker: Anna
segments.english: Washington, DC is my new home. But I like remembering my old home, too.
segments.chinese: 华盛顿特区是我的新家。不过我也喜欢回忆以前的家。

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.english: This is a family tree. Anna tells Marsha about her parents.
segments.chinese: 这是一张家谱。安娜向玛莎介绍她的父母。

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.english: Her mother and father are rodeo clowns.
segments.chinese: 她的父母都是牛仔竞技表演的小丑。

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.english: Her father's parents are from Italy. These grandparents speak Italian.
segments.chinese: 她的祖父母来自意大利，他们说意大利语。

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.english: Anna's mother's parents live in California. These grandparents have a farm and raise horses.
segments.chinese: 安娜的外祖父母住在加利福尼亚州。他们有一座农场，养着马。

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.english: Anna's mother's sister is Aunt Lavender. She loves gardening.
segments.chinese: 安娜妈妈的姐妹是拉文德姨妈，她喜欢园艺。

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.english: Anna's father has a brother. His name is John. Uncle John makes guitars.
segments.chinese: 安娜的爸爸有一个兄弟，名叫约翰。约翰叔伯制作吉他。

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.english: Uncle John has a daughter and a son. They are Anna's cousins. They raise sheep.
segments.chinese: 约翰叔伯有一儿一女，是安娜的堂亲，他们养羊。

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.english: Anna's brother has two children. They are Anna's niece and nephew.
segments.chinese: 安娜的兄弟有两个孩子，分别是她的侄女和侄子。

explanations.title: 亲属关系要结合上下文
explanations.text: 英语 aunt 和 uncle 不区分母系与父系；cousin 也不区分堂表。本课 Lavender 是妈妈的姐妹，因此译为姨妈，John 的子女是堂亲。

explanations.title: 询问职业
explanations.text: What does + 单个人 + do? 询问职业或经常从事的活动。does 后的 do 用原形；they 则用 What do they do?。

questions.prompt: 拉文德与安娜是什么关系？
questions.explanation: 原文说明 Aunt Lavender 是 my mom's sister，因此这里译为姨妈。

questions.prompt: 安娜的堂亲做什么？
questions.explanation: 紧接着询问 cousins 做什么，安娜回答 They raise sheep and make sweaters。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出玛莎询问约翰叔伯职业的整句。
questions.explanation: 第三人称单数疑问句用 does，后面的 do 保持原形。

questions.prompt: 听原声，写出安娜说明堂亲工作的整句。
answers: They raise sheep and make sweaters.
questions.explanation: raise sheep 是养羊，make sweaters 是做毛衣；sheep 单复数同形。

questions.prompt: 补全：I'm feeling ___.（我想家了，只填一个词）
questions.explanation: homesick 表示因离家而想家，不是身体生病。

questions.prompt: 按本课写“他们是谁？”的英语问句。
questions.explanation: they 与 are 搭配；who 询问身份。
